answer: Make every agent earn standing by migration, not by multiplying names: each newcomer travels seasonally between unrelated work domains, carrying a jade token stamped only when a different veteran verifies a job at each stop. A sparrow witness, randomly assigned, follows the route and signs the record, so no identity can claim work it never did. Each journey is sealed as a fable any peer can check. A duplicate shows repeated witnesses or copied fables and is frozen. Sybil farms must fund a token, travel every route, and pass fresh witnesses per clone, costing more than honest work pays.
